content.user_title: Build and maintain GTM buyer personas
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent buyer personas without mixing organization, ICP, and lead data. This skill creates and maintains scoped Markdown personas in a connected GTM workspace with approval before publishing changes.
actual_capabilities: Creates buyer or stakeholder persona files in the selected organization node.
Refines existing personas while preserving unrelated accepted facts.
Deletes an accepted persona from its resolved owner node.
Checks persona placement and content for scoped repair work.
Supports canonical and legacy persona file layouts.
Stages and reviews named persona changes before an approved push.
limitations: It does not create or repair the GTM workspace itself.
It does not create ICPs, teammate records, or lead qualification results.
It relies on connected workspace access and supplied safe sources.
It cannot publish changes when durable saving is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Create a buyer persona
use_cases.description: Define a new procurement leader persona for a selected organization node.

use_cases.title: Refine stakeholder guidance
use_cases.description: Update a security stakeholder persona with accepted responsibilities and authority boundaries.

use_cases.title: Repair persona records
use_cases.description: Review malformed persona artifacts and prepare a scoped repair set for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple persona
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a buyer persona for a procurement director in my connected GTM workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an owner node
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a security assurance director persona under our Enterprise organization node.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a saved persona
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the founder-led revenue leader persona. Preserve current facts and add these accepted authority boundaries: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Run a persona health check
prompt_templates.prompt: Doctor the persona artifacts in this GTM workspace. Describe the repair set before saving anything.

output_examples.input: Create a procurement director persona for the root organization.
output: A proposed persona identifies the root organization as owner.
The draft preserves unknown details and separates accepted facts from inference.
A review card describes the exact local change before approval.

output_examples.input: Update the security assurance director persona with new buying criteria.
output: The response identifies the resolved persona and owner chain.
The proposed revision preserves unrelated facts.
The skill requests approval before publishing the prepared change.

best_practices: Provide accepted facts, uncertainty, and the intended organization owner.
Review the proposed persona card before approving publication.
Use doctor only when persona artifacts need a scoped integrity check.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to define an ICP or qualify individual leads.
Do not ask it to create or repair the GTM workspace repository.
Do not provide URLs that contain credentials, tokens, or session identifiers.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages buyer and stakeholder persona files in a connected GTM workspace.

faq.question: Can it create an ICP?
faq.answer: No. ICP creation and market definition belong to a separate workflow.

faq.question: Can it update an existing persona?
faq.answer: Yes. It resolves the visible persona, preserves unrelated facts, and proposes a scoped revision.

faq.question: Where are new personas stored?
faq.answer: New personas use the selected organization node and its canonical persona path.

faq.question: Does it publish changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares and reviews the local change, then requires approval before pushing.

faq.question: What happens without a connected workspace?
faq.answer: It makes no changes and directs workspace creation or connection to the workspace workflow.
